name: 18161-mixedprompt-8b-1gpu
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. V1 engine core, one in-process engine; the environment variables the setup requires are in configs/tuned.yaml.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=512, bounded at 3072 requests / 1800 s safety, warmup the first 25% by completion.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets. ShareGPT-shaped mixed-length chat: prompt ~213 tokens (stdev 244, 16..1024), output ~127 tokens (stdev 130, 16..1024), forced to the declared length rather than stopping at EOS. request_format is `plain`, so the declared prompt length is the wire length; the default chat-template path is not usable with this engine's tokenizer wrapper.
purpose: A general-purpose chat assistant on one GPU, serving 512 concurrent users short mixed-length single-turn conversations.
launch:
# Engine arguments for commit 451da4bcbdc2dcabf3e319b4a82b72674c33f4de.
# Interpreter and hardware: configs/env.yaml.  Environment variables: configs/tuned.yaml.

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-model-len: 4096

# The engine's own V1 default here is ON, so this line is load-bearing.
enable-prefix-caching: false

max-num-batched-tokens: 8192

# Caps how many requests may be RUNNING at once: must stay at or above the declared stream
# count, or the closed loop is throttled by the engine rather than by the hardware.
max-num-seqs: 1024

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
dtype: bfloat16
